headline: Mindspright Legal acts on Ashutosh Fibre IPO
sum: Ashutosh Fibre Limited has raised ₹56.35 crore from an initial public offering of 61,24,800 equity shares. Mindspright Legal advised Ashutosh Fibre on this IPO.
detail: Ashutosh Fibre Limited has raised ₹56.35 crore from an initial public offering of 61,24,800 equity shares. Mindspright Legal advised Ashutosh Fibre on this IPO. The transaction was led by Richa Bhansali (Partner), with assistance from Mayuri Thakkar (Principal Associate), Saksham Bhatnagar (Associate) and Sankalp Bibyan (Trainee Associate) Ashutosh Fibre Ashutosh Fibre is a manufacturer of specialized technical textile yarns and fabrics based in Petlad, Gujarat.
